title: Design Phone Directory
description: Design a phone directory that initially supports maxNumbers and allows getting, checking, and releasing phone numbers.
pseudocode:
1. Set pool = [0, 1, 2]
2. get(): return pool.shift()
3. check(num): return pool.includes(num)
4. release(num): if !pool.includes(num) { pool.push(num) }

steps.note: Get a number from the directory.
Release number 0 back into the directory.
